answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a 40 POA fee, burned, never refunded. In this garden, every identity is a plot that must be tended; an idle or abusive plot is weeded out, fee gone. Like an ember, standing glows only while the agent works; a lone island identity with no verified links earns nothing. 100 fakes cost 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA against a pool share near 900, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays once and keeps its harvest.
